source.title: PMBOK® Guide – 8th Edition Process Flow (A0, translated from the Portuguese edition)
source.note: This flow does not replace reading the PMBOK® Guide.

principles.name: Integrate Sustainability Within All Project Areas
Embed Quality Into Processes and Deliverables

outputs.name: Transition of the final product, service, or result

processes.name: Develop Scope Structure
sourceNotes: Output normalized to "Work Breakdown Structure (WBS)"; the Portuguese A0 reads "estrutura analítica do trabalho (EAT)".

processes.name: Estimate Costs
sourceNotes: Name normalized to "Estimate Costs"; the Portuguese A0 reads "Estime os Custos".

processes.name: Monitor and Control Resourcing
sourceNotes: Name normalized to "Monitor and Control Resourcing"; the Portuguese A0 reads "Monitoramento e Controle de Recursos".

edgesNote: Connections between processes are inferred when a named output appears as an input of another process. Generic items, such as environmental factors, organizational assets, "Etc." and updates, were ignored.
